description: This file defines a Python module for logging database operation metrics and handling exceptions during database operations in an asynchronous context. It provides a decorator for wrapping functions to automatically log success and failure events to an external ServiceLogger, integrating with observability tools like Prometheus, OTEL, and Datadog.

methods.name: log_db_metrics(func)
methods.description: A decorator function that wraps an async function to log execution success or failure metrics to an external service, including handling exceptions related to database errors.

methods.name: bool _is_exception_related_to_db(e: Exception)
methods.description: Checks if an exception is related to database errors such as Prisma errors or HTTP connection/timeout errors.

methods.name: None _handle_logging_db_exception( e: Exception, func: Callable, kwargs: Dict, args: Tuple, start_time: datetime, end_time: datetime, )
methods.description: Handles the logging of database-related exceptions by invoking the external logging hooks with details of the exception and function execution timing.

ctags.name: _handle_logging_db_exception
ctags.signature: ( e: Exception, func: Callable, kwargs: Dict, args: Tuple, start_time: datetime, end_time: datetime, )
